✨ Interview Journey at Goldman Sachs – Offer Secured! ✨
I'm thrilled to share that I’ve successfully received an offer from Goldman Sachs! 🙌
The interview process was one of the most intellectually stimulating experiences I’ve had so far, pushing me to think deeply about data structures, algorithms, and scalable systems.
Here’s a quick overview of the process:
🔹 Online Coding Round
 Tackled graph-based problems that tested both algorithmic depth and optimization.
🔹 Round 1 – Core DSA
 Focused on hashmap-based logic and mathematical problem-solving.
🔹 Round 2 – Advanced Algorithms
 Covered concepts like Dijkstra’s algorithm and complex dynamic programming.
🔹 Round 3 – System Design (Core Concepts)
 Designed a caching system with expiry — a good mix of real-world applicability and complexity.
🔹 Round 4 – Product-Level System Design
Designed a system similar to large-scale ticket booking platforms, focusing on handling high traffic, ensuring data accuracy, and preventing downtime.
🔹 Round 5 – Hiring Manager Discussion
 Discussed designing a system to handle file uploads and enable metadata-based search. Explored indexing strategies, storage efficiency, and architecture trade-offs.
This entire journey has been a huge learning curve for me. I'm thankful to the interviewers for the engaging discussions and to everyone who supported me during the prep phase.
Excited for what lies ahead! 🚀
#InterviewExperience #SystemDesign #DSA #BackendEngineering #CareerMilestone #SoftwareEngineering
